claim: The element the configuration calls csuw1_bright, offered as confocal or bright field, and the element it calls csuw1_disk_position, offered as in or out, are one mechanism recorded twice under two names. Moving the disk in or out is the only thing either name selects.
validity_conditions: This instrument as configured on 2026-09-17, operator read at the instrument. Which of the two names micromanager actually addresses is not settled by this claim and is recorded as a gap: setting one property and reading back the other would show an agreement that means nothing. Falsified by the two names proving independently settable.
